title: Known-object test, TOI-3223.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3223.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Residual screen: 851 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 189 distinct event(s), 110 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
